en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a military cemetery set in a clearing by a forest. There is a tall central obelisk-style monument surrounded by numerous grave markers arranged in rows, many of them crosses. Groups of people are gathered around the monument and graves, suggesting a ceremony or commemoration. A dirt road runs along the front edge. Printed caption text appears below the image.
